report_name: CRPxO Ransomware Claims Breach of Encore Enterprises

threat_actors.name: CRPxO
threat_actors.description: An emerging ransomware group that appeared in late 2025. It operates a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model and is known for its double-extortion tactics, which involve exfiltrating data before encrypting victim systems and threatening to publish the stolen data on its leak site.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through data theft and system encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The CRPxO group claimed to have exfiltrated 700 GB of internal company data from Encore Enterprises as part of their double-extortion attack.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: As part of its double-extortion model, the CRPxO group deploys its ransomware payload to encrypt files across the victim's network, causing business disruption and creating leverage for ransom demands.

attack_patterns.name: Archive via Utility
attack_patterns.description: The typical modus operandi for CRPxO includes using an archiving utility, such as 7-Zip, to compress sensitive data into archives before exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups like CRPxO often delete volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin to prevent easy system recovery.

malware.name: CRPxO Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload deployed by the CRPxO group to encrypt victim systems after data exfiltration.

tools.name: Rclone
tools.description: The command-line tool rclone.exe is often abused by ransomware groups like CRPxO to exfiltrate data to cloud storage providers.

identities.name: Encore Enterprises, Inc.
identities.description: A U.S.-based commercial real estate company that was listed on the CRPxO ransomware group's data leak site. The group claimed to have exfiltrated 700 GB of data from the company.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1c3d-e4f5-4a90-8bcd-ef1234567890
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common precursor to ransomware deployment.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/encore-enterprises-inc-crpxo-2026-08
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a technique often used by ransomware groups like CRPxO to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Data Archiving with 7-Zip for Exfiltration
indicators.pattern:
title: Data Archiving with 7-Zip for Exfiltration
id: 8c7b6a5d-4f3e-4d2c-1b0a-987654321fed
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 7-Zip to create password-protected archives, a common technique used by ransomware groups to stage data for exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/encore-enterprises-inc-crpxo-2026-08
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\7z.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' a '
      - ' -p'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the 7-Zip utility to create archives, a common data staging technique used by groups like CRPxO before exfiltration.
